body.objective: Determine the minimal bosonic charge-neutral higher-composite carrier capable of realizing the rank-two negative BT eight-point profile block, and test its ghost-parity compatibility with the neutral term in Eq. 19.
activates: an exact charged symmetric-Fock metric over the two hard-profile fibres
a minimal charge-neutral rank-two lift of the fourth-profile block
a ghost-parity test against the Eq. 19 neutral operator
body.current_gate: NEUTRAL_BOSONIC_COMPOSITE: construct the symmetric bosonic powers of the two certified cross-Krein charge fibres, locate the first neutral sector with negative index at least two, reproduce K4 there, and determine whether the resulting block is ghost even.
body.stop_condition: Land an exact certificate with an independent verifier that proves minimal tensor degree, reconstructs both hard-profile amplitudes, records charge and ghost parity, and does not call an algebraic composite lift the BT projector, generalized-Born trace, probability, gravity, or Lorentzian physics.
body.forbid: no unsymmetrized tensor called bosonic; no charge-zero label without the total generator; no negative-index count inferred numerically; no ghost-odd block called the ghost-even P term of Eq. 19; no algebraic lift called BT-derived, probabilistic, gravitational, or LORENTZIAN-CAUSAL
body.resource_hint: In the two-profile charge fibre let p_i and m_i have charges plus/minus one and pair by <p_i,m_j>=rho^2 delta_ij. The degree-2 neutral sector is the 2x2 transpose pairing and has negative index one. At degree 4, use plus and minus occupation types (2,0),(1,1),(0,2); the induced pairing swaps the two occupation labels and has inertia (6,3). Antisymmetric occupation pairs give three exact negative directions. Test the two equal-norm pairs (20,11) and (11,02) against K4.
